_how_to_update: Once a month, after the World Gold Council publishes its central bank statistics (early each month on gold.org/goldhub), edit these numbers and commit. The daily fetch reads this file; there is no free API for official gold reserves.
source: World Gold Council preliminary data, via Seoul Economic Daily and Kitco
highlights: China (PBoC) added 21 t in September, its largest monthly purchase in three years and its 23rd month of buying in a row; reserves 2,196 t.
Poland holds about 648 t, close to its 700 t target.
